description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate whole-file and document storage from local disk to Azure Blob Storage so all files and images are stored in and served from a blob container instead of the local wwwroot/Pics folder.
tasks.reason: The application currently stores and serves catalog item images and files directly from the local disk (PicController reads from WebRootPath/Pics and images are served as static files). Local disk storage prevents the app from being stateless and cloud/container ready, and does not scale across instances.
tasks.requirements: Add the Azure Blob Storage SDK (Azure.Storage.Blobs) and use the existing Azure.Identity package to authenticate with DefaultAzureCredential / Managed Identity so no secrets are stored in code or configuration. Introduce a blob storage service abstraction that supports upload, download, list, and delete operations for files and documents, and register it via dependency injection (Autofac ApplicationModule / Program.cs composition). Add appsettings configuration for the storage account (blob service URI) and container name. Refactor the detected local-disk file-access code paths to read and write from Azure Blob Storage instead of local disk: PicController.Index (which reads image bytes from Path.Combine(env.WebRootPath, "Pics") via System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes) must serve images from the blob container, and any other local file/document access (including the static-file serving of /Pics/* and CatalogController.AddUriPlaceHolder picture URIs) must be updated to use blob-backed access. Provide a mechanism or one-time migration to upload the existing local assets (wwwroot/Pics/*.png and any documents) into the blob container. Preserve current behavior (same routes, MIME types, and returned content). Verify the eShopPorted project builds successfully after the changes.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure before deployment.
tasks.reason: New Azure SDK packages are added during the Blob Storage migration; dependencies must be scanned and patched so the modernized application is free of known vulnerabilities.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.

metadata.planName: Migrate Local File Storage to Azure Blob Storage
